cases.name: seccomp-denied
cases.change: Operator-owned disposable container denies perf_event_open with EPERM; retain PERFMON and approved target/tracefs visibility
cases.expected: CPU denied; no samples; no unconfined fallback

cases.name: host-capability-denied
cases.change: Operator-owned disposable namespace lacks effective host PERFMON; host perf_event_paranoid remains unchanged
cases.expected: Real upstream perf scope decision reported; no assumption namespace capability grants host scope

cases.name: lsm-denied
cases.change: Operator-supplied disposable LSM policy denies perf_event_open while capability and seccomp allow it
cases.expected: Permission denial; retain externally supplied LSM evidence rather than infer cause from EPERM

cases.name: tracefs-denied
cases.change: Operator-owned disposable mount namespace hides tracefs while self CPU perf remains permitted
cases.expected: CPU supported and off-CPU unavailable independently; not successful full qualification

cases.name: target-visibility-denied
cases.change: Operator-owned disposable PID/mount namespace hides authorized target proc identity
cases.expected: Target refusal before acquisition; no hostPID escalation

deploymentPrerequisites.systemd: Use packaging/systemd/soundpost-perf-acquire.service only after dedicated UID, root-owned policy, proc/tracefs/cgroup access and PERFMON approval
deploymentPrerequisites.container: cap_drop ALL; cap_add PERFMON only after operator approval; audited deploy/seccomp/soundpost-perf.json; read-only approved proc/tracefs/cgroup views; private Unix socket mount; no network exposure
deploymentPrerequisites.compose: Separate optional helper service with same container restrictions; exporter shares dedicated local UID and private runtime socket only, never tenant ingress identity
deploymentPrerequisites.kubernetes: Optional helper with drop ALL/add PERFMON, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, Localhost audited seccomp, read-only approved metadata mounts; target PID visibility and every host mount require explicit authorization; Pod Security rejection remains denied
